page.signedOut: Log in to manage the languages of a story.
page.notFound: That story isn’t among the stories of this account.

add.heading: Add a language
add.title: Title in that language
add.note: You translate it yourself, with the original beside you; other members can’t translate the story. Chapters appear in this language as you publish them; until then readers get a link to the original.
add.noneLeft: This story is already in every language open for writing.

problems.titleMissing: Add a title in that language.
problems.languageTaken: This story already has that language.
problems.tooMany: A story can have up to {{max}} languages.
problems.failed: The language wasn’t added. Check the connection and try again.

side.heading: One story, many languages
side.body: Every language is an edition of the same story: likes and reads add up into one total, and readers can switch language at any chapter. The language switch shows only once a story has two languages.

chapters.intro: Translate one chapter at a time, with the original beside it. A chapter can be published here once the original is published.
chapters.empty: The original has no chapters yet.
chapters.startFailed: The translation couldn’t be started. Check the connection and try again.
chapters.notAnEdition: This is the original of the story. Pick a language to translate into.

details.heading: Title and description
details.title: Title in {{language}}
details.failed: Not saved. Check the connection and try again.

remove.heading: Remove this language
remove.body: The {{language}} edition and its chapters are deleted. The original and the other languages stay.
remove.confirm: Remove {{language}}? It can be brought back for 30 days, under Recently deleted on the Write page.
remove.failed: The language wasn’t removed. Check the connection and try again.

editor.tip: The original and the translation stay side by side. A paragraph you leave empty is shown to readers in the original until it’s translated.
editor.fullEditorHint: For headings, pictures and other formatting.
editor.noParagraphs: The original chapter has no text yet.
editor.notFound: That chapter isn’t among the translations of this account.
editor.loadFailed: The chapter couldn’t be loaded. Check the connection and try again.

outcomes.conflict: This chapter was saved somewhere else since it was opened. Reload the page to get the latest text.
outcomes.originalNotPublished: Publish the original chapter first. The translation is saved as a draft.
outcomes.empty: Translate at least one paragraph before publishing.
outcomes.tooLong: The text is too long to save.
outcomes.failed: Not saved. Check the connection and try again.

phone.heading: Translate on a bigger screen
phone.line: Translating a chapter works on a tablet or computer, where the original and your translation fit side by side. Your draft of Chapter {{number}} in {{language}} is saved.
